---
title: "Publish"
---

This module puts your site online.

## Publish to GitHub Pages

Run this command in the folder of your site.
Quarto renders the site and sends it to the branch `gh-pages` of your repository.

```{.bash .terminal}
$ quarto publish gh-pages
```

## After the workshop

Replace the sample pages of this template with your own material.
Each page can have a `duration`.
A page without a `duration` gets no timer.
